name: CSC Stat Viewer
author: ethan@example.com
description: A React/Vite statistics viewer application with automatic GitHub updates.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; /usr/local/bin/npm install; /usr/local/bin/npm run build; /usr/local/bin/npx serve -s build -l tcp://${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
echo -e "Starting CSC Stat Viewer installation..."
echo -e "Installing system dependencies..."
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git
echo -e "Git installed."

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo -e "Working directory: $(pwd)"

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

echo -e "Git address: ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
echo -e "Branch: ${BRANCH}"

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "Directory not empty, checking for existing repo..."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e "Existing git repo found, pulling updates..."
        git pull
    else
        echo -e "Files exist but no git repo. Skipping clone."
    fi
else
    echo -e "Cloning repository..."
    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

echo -e "Files in directory:"
ls -la

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo -e "Installing npm packages..."
    npm install
    echo -e "npm install complete."
else
    echo -e "ERROR: package.json not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "Installation complete!"
exit 0

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.
